name: TrueNAS
author: Netlens
description: Reads a TrueNAS (Community Edition 25.04 or newer) and shows it as a host with what runs on it: containers and virtual machines (matched to the devices on your network by IP or MAC address) and apps. Read-only: one login with an API key, a few reads, then it disconnects.

config.label: TrueNAS systems
config.help: The address of the TrueNAS web interface. Always use https: TrueNAS revokes an API key that is used over an unencrypted connection, so this plugin refuses plain http (an http:// address is changed to https://). Create a separate user for Netlens with a read-only role (for example Readonly Admin), then in the user menu at the top right choose API Keys > Add for that user and paste the key here.

config.label: Verify TLS certificate
config.help: TrueNAS uses a self-signed certificate until you install your own. Leave this off in that case.

dashboard.title: TrueNAS workloads
dashboard.about: Apps, containers and virtual machines on your TrueNAS: running and stopped.
